title: The Man in the High Castle
author: Philip K. Dick
summary: In an alternate 1960s where the Axis powers won the Second World War, America is divided between Japan and Germany. Several ordinary people on the Pacific coast cross paths, with a banned novel about a different outcome in the background.
readIf: you like alternate-history stories that are more about unsettled reality than plot.
skipIf: you want a clear, action-led resolution, because this one is quiet and ambiguous.

pairings.reason: Another classic about life under total control, with a darker and more direct view of tyranny.
The same author in a similar vein, questioning what is real and what makes a person human.
A near-future regime shown through one narrow, personal viewpoint.
